source_bridge: Source Model3 reproduce_kb / population.advance unmodified, fixed B48. From newly proven one-mutant positive reproductive externality in 14 source conflict cells, representative delayed_control/resident [.2,.35,.35] K8.
primary_question: Can evolution of genomic floral investment LOWER population-mean investment and reduce unconditional persistence relative to a genomic-mean expression clamp when focal reproductive selection is negative but group seed production and nonfocal paternal externality are positive?
scope: Source-controlled 16-new-pilot-history viability/safety/design-screen, not an independent 192-history confirmatory trial or evidence of evolutionary commons tragedy.

genotypes.varied_locus: investment; two source homologs per parent, continuous-valued, variation from fixed 8-parent founder RNG
genotypes.investment_support_envelope: Verify [2*min_investment_homolog - max, 2*max - min] subset of [0,1] before trajectories.

mechanism.dynamic_visitor_recruitment: for stochastic_matched4 source make_history uses original arrival/loss, conditional on 4 matching visitors at t0; static_matched4 holds these same 4 identical types/count each year
mechanism.viability_gate: baseline only: no new seed-depression treatment

expression_policies.native: Use original allele-dosage investment expression in source reproduce_kb; original Mendelian inheritance fully retained.
expression_policies.baseline_centered: Each year immediately before reproduce_kb, shift all investment HOMOLOG expressions by constant (original founder mean investment-current mean genetic investment) if nonextinct; pass unmodified raw parental DNA into population.advance; thus preserve within-population trait differences and original Mendelian inherited alleles, not a genetic evolution freeze.

selection_diagnostic: Original monomorphic at [.2,.35,.35] and B48 investment beta <0, Gamma_seed >0, all-original 14 discordant case externality >0; evaluate here only with initial N0=8, not claim dynamic beta sign follows automatically.
readiness_gates: Exact first-reproduction source ledger and t1 actual genotype ID/allele state identical across both policies for every paired pilot history.
Initial standing investment genetic variation >0; matching and assurance loci are invariant over entire history and no new mutation.
Direct phenotype recentering changes original source ledger only, not inherited genome; no unsafe phenotype clipping.
Confirm source embryo budget/seed-pollen accounting, no visitor negative externality unaffected.
NO chosen confirmatory budget if either arm persist occupancy at H80 uniformly floor or ceiling across pilot16; 16-path proportions used only for engineering targeting not evidence.
Reserve new unused visitor RNG history family and power calculation before future confirmatory outcome; all 384 pilot outcomes must be archived.

power_scenarios.estimand: Paired P(occupied80_native)-P(occupied80_centered) per visitor history, benefit/harm direction specified prospectively before confirmatory run.
power_scenarios.CI: Conservative Bonferroni-combined Clopper-Pearson binomial 95% exclusive discordance event intervals; require signed bound >5pp.
power_scenarios.conditional_on: Independent visitor-history unit. No study allowed to retroactively substitute a tighter bound after observing data.

stop: This task only runs the complete predeclared feasibility pilot and hypothetical power scenarios; does not use or generate confirmatory visitor-history IDs, does not optimize to desired effect sign.
scientific_limit: The t0 centered-expression arm has initial identical phenotype but later removes population-mean investment change, not investment allele transmission/within-population phenotype evolution. Therefore even if it changes survival, it does not by itself prove evolutionary suicide or a natural island tragedy of commons.
